alex: heads up, my kicker got ruled out 20 mins before kickoff. waiver deadline in 1.5h. anyone grab a kicker I should poach? :grimacing:
priya: ugh that sucks. whos available?
jamal: look at the waiver list: Cade Miller, J. Doe (FA), and streaming options in week tilt. id grab Cade if nobody objects.
emily: quick PSA: dont forget IR slot if you have space, frees a bench spot.
alex: i have 1 bench spot. thinking J. Doe since he jets in a high-scoring matchup. thoughts?
priya: JDoe has "+6" projections tho. id do that.
jamal: fine but if JDoe misses i'm taking your wings. big loser snack bet: loser brings wings to friday standup. :chicken:
emily: stakes accepted. can we add a kicker-specific lobby? :joy: remember last years 0-point kicker disaster.
alex: want to do auto-claim now? /waiver claim JDoe --priority 3
waiver-bot: @alex Claim queued: JDoe (K). Priority: 3. Estimated resolution: 45m.
priya: also reminder: opportunistic streaming works if your opponent has a strong defense that reduces kicker opportunities. check weather/snap counts.
jamal: weather check: wind 15mph at stadium C. potential for long fg attempts. +1 to JDoe gamble.
emily: narrative: alex gambles, jamal trolls, wings are in jeopardy. this thread is sponsor of tonight's snacks. :popcorn:
alex: if claim fails i'll try Cade. also open to a coinflip instead of wings if both teams tie this week?
priya: coinflip would be very on-brand. :coin:
jamal: no coinflip. wings or nothing.
waiver-bot: Update: Claim processed for JDoe to alex. Transaction ID: 7f3b21.
emily: congrats alex. now go secure some clean jersey karma. :pray:
alex: fingers crossed. will post final lineup screenshot in 30m. losers start planning wing orders.
